"''That's right. Minimal casualties, maximum effectiveness. That's us.|Matchstick and Broadside|audio=MaxEffectiveness-SoM.flac|}} '''Matchstick''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Matchstick was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], flying under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Shadow Two/Legends|"Shadow Two"]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], while Matchstick and Shadow [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] were serving under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] began attacking a number of Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Following the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]], Matchstick and Shadow Squadron accompanied Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Bormus Testing Facility]] to retrieve several [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] for an [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|upcoming assault]] on the ''Malevolence''. After acquiring the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], Skywalker developed a plan to destroy the ''Malevolence'' with the newly acquired [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] by ambushing the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]. After being briefed about their mission aboard Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], Matchstick and Shadow Squadron—with Skywalker in the lead—departed the ''Resolute'' and took a dangerous [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] to intercept the ''Malevolence''. During the journey, Matchstick's bomber was damaged after a large [[Neebray/Legends|neebray manta]]—a [[Limb/Legends|winged]] [[vacuumbreather]] nesting in the nebula—grazed his fighter's port [[Engine/Legends|engine]], although the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was able to continue on with his squadron. Upon emerging from the nebula, Shadow Squadron engaged the ''Malevolence'' and the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] that it deployed. When the massive warship fired its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]] on the squadron, Matchsticks' engines failed while attempting evasive maneuvers due to the damage inflicted by the neebray manta. Losing control of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Matchstick collided with squadmate [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] Y-wing, which [[Death/Legends|killed]] both pilots. ==Biography== ===Acquiring the Y-wings=== {{Quote|We've got a Jedi, you don't. I think that qualifies as authorization.|Matchstick, to the guards of Hangar 8122|''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''}} [[File:MatchstickBroadsideBormus-TCWProcedure.png|thumb|right|250px|Matchstick and Broadside at the Bormus Testing Facility]] [[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] on the [[Water/Legends|water]]-[[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] nicknamed Matchstick served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Matchstick was created from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was in [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]],{{TCWA|Daily Trivia}} flying under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Shadow Two." During his tenure in Shadow Squadron, Matchstick formed a close friendship with squadmate and fellow pilot [[Broadside/Legends|Broadside]], with whom Matchstick often [[Gambling/Legends|bet]] on outgoing missions as a sort of ritual and good luck charm. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Matchstick and Shadow Squadron were under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] command, stationed on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]], began ambushing Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' was equipped with dual [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]], which were capable of disabling any [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and [[Engine/Legends|engines]].''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' Skywalker, wanting to hunt down the ''Malevolence'' and destroy it, decided to retrieve several units of the Republic's newly designed [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] to use against the Confederate warship. Matchstick and the rest of Shadow Squadron accompanied Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], in the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]—Skywalker's personal [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]]—to the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Bormus Testing Facility]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] tasked with manufacturing and testing the Y-wing [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. After encountering protest from a [[Unidentified Gran worker|Gran worker]] at the facility, Skywalker ordered Matchstick and Broadside to enter the facility's [[Hangar 8122]], where the Y-wings were being stored. While Skywalker and Tano manipulated the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] into authorizing the release of the bombers, Matchstick and Broadside informed the clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] guarding the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that orders from a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] qualified as the clearance needed to enter the hangar. Matchstick and the rest of Shadow Squadron departed the facility with twelve of the Y-wings, while Skywalker and Tano departed in the ''Twilight''. ===Attack on the ''Malevolence''=== {{Quote|We lost Matchstick and Tag.|Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:Matchstick2.png|thumb|left|250px|Matchstick pilots his new Y-wing bomber.]] Shadow Squadron flew the Y-wing bombers back to the ''Resolute'', and there they were briefed by Skywalker and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], the commander of the ''Resolute''. Skywalker explained his plan for destroying the ''Malevolence'' to Matchstick and the rest of the squadron: by using the newly acquired Y-wings, Shadow Squadron—with Skywalker in the lead—would slip through the warship's defenses and attack the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge tower]]. Following the briefing, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who had survived an [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|earlier encounter]] with the ''Malevolence'', asked if the squadron was skilled enough to accomplish the very difficult task. Matchstick and Broadside both assured Koon that their squadron was capable of completing the mission. Shortly thereafter, Yularen reported that the ''Malevolence'' had [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|obliterated]] a Republic medical [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]]. Since [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]] was close to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and since Grievous had attacked a medical convoy, Skywalker concluded that Grievous's next target was the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], located near Naboo. The [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] contained over 60,000 injured clone troopers, and, without the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], the Republic would have nowhere else to send its wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. With this new piece of information, Skywalker devised a plan to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|ambush]] the ''Malevolence'' near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] before the warship could reach the medical center. In order to do so, Shadow Squadron would need to go through the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]], a dangerous shortcut through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. Shadow Squadron would be accompanied by Koon and [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|another Jedi Knight]]{{TCWA|Starfighter}} piloting [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B light interceptors]]. Each Y-wing would also have a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard to operate the bombers' [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] turrets, with Tano serving as Skywalker's gunner. Before leaving, Matchstick made a bet with Broadside, saying that if they survived the upcoming battle, drinks were on Matchstick. Shadow Squadron and their escorts left the ''Resolute'' and soon entered the Kaliida Nebula, beginning the Balmorra Run. However, as they were flying through the nebula, the group encountered several giant [[Neebray/Legends|neebray mantas]], [[Limb/Legends|winged]] [[vacuumbreather]]s that were nesting along the route. Skywalker ordered the squadron to follow him in the single-file [[Bantha formation/Legends|Bantha formation]] to avoid colliding with the neebrays, but Matchstick was unable to prevent a manta from grazing his bomber's port-side engine, destroying his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the process. When asked by Koon if his ship was in stable condition, Matchstick, trying to downplay the incident, claimed that the damage was insignificant and continued on with his squadron. Shadow Squadron eventually emerged from the nebula, arriving at the medcenter shortly before the ''Malevolence'' emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] nearby in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. [[File:MatchstickDeath-ShadowOfMalevolence.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Matchstick's engine fails.]] Launching its assault, Shadow Squadron and its escorts [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] deployed by Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], attempting to push past the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and attack the ''Malevolence'' directly. Upon Grievous's orders, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stationed aboard the ''Malevolence'' fired the warship's starboard ion pulse cannon at the Republic starfighters, hoping to disable them. As the ion cannon's ray approached the Republic squadron, Skywalker immediately ordered his fighters to head for the top edge of the ray to avoid its effects. However, three members of Shadow Squadron were unable to avoid the ray, which deactivated their Y-wing bombers as well as most of the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Also during the squadron's evasive maneuver, Matchstick's right engine failed due to the damage he had sustained from the neebray manta,{{CSWECite|I|293|Matchstick}} causing his fighter to collide with his squadmate [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] Y-wing. The ships exploded, [[Death/Legends|killing]] both pilots and their gunners. Even though he was not the only casualty of the battle, Matchstick's death deeply affected the squadron, especially [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Tano. However, his squadron, as a tribute to their fallen comrade,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' were able to disable both of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion pulse cannons, which allowed an incoming Republic fleet under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to engage the damaged ''Malevolence'', saving the medcenter from destruction. Skywalker and Kenobi later infiltrated the warship during the battle and sabotaged its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], causing the ''Malevolence'' to crash into a nearby [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|moon]].{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Broadside, we make it through this one, drinks are on me.''"
"''I can already taste it.|Matchstick and Broadside|audio=DrinksAreOnMe-SoM.flac|}} [[File:ShadowSquadron.png|thumb|left|250px|Broadside and Matchstick, talking before their last mission together]] A veteran clone pilot, Matchstick was trained at an early age to fly a variety of different starships, including [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], bombers, and starfighters. During his training, Matchstick developed exceptional [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]] and quick reflexes—which he used to great effect in battle—and used a [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15 blaster pistol]] in combat. A tough and confident pilot, he welcomed a chance to use the newly developed BTL-B Y-wing starfighters. When his bomber collided with a neebray manta, Matchstick downplayed the damage to his bomber. However, this overconfidence would cause his death, as his bomber was greatly affected by the encounter with the neebray, later being destroyed during the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula. Matchstick and his squadmate Broadside developed a close friendship during the Clone Wars, often betting on the outcome of their missions. During the mission to the Bormus Testing facility, Matchstick followed the orders of General Anakin Skywalker to retrieve the Y-wing bombers, even when they conflicted with the orders of higher-ranking officials, including [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Matchstick kept his head of [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] shaved and had brown eyes and tan skin. Like all other clone troopers, he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Matchstick-TCW.png|thumb|right|150px|A promotional image of Matchstick in full flight armor]] In [[2008]], Matchstick first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'', an [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|online comic]] that led directly into "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Matchstick later appeared in "Shadow of ''Malevolence''," being voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all of the clone troopers in the series. In [[2009]], [[Hasbro]] released a Matchstick action figure in the tenth wave of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' toy line]].{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#34: Matchstick|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW34_Matchstick.asp}} ===Discrepancies=== Matchstick's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly states that the pilot's call sign was "[[Shadow Three/Legends|Shadow Three]]," when multiple sources—including "Shadow of ''Malevolence''" and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''—have made it clear that Matchstick's true call sign was Shadow Two. ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' also says that Matchstick died after his Y-wing bomber was hit by an ion blast from the ''Malevolence'', when in fact "Shadow of ''Malevolence''" shows that Matchstick lost control of his damaged starfighter during evasive maneuvers and crashed into Tag's Y-wing, killing both pilots. The "Daily Trivia" quiz game of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] states that Matchstick was the commander of Shadow Squadron. However, it has not yet been made clear if this was subject to or conflicting with General Skywalker's role during the events of "Shadow of ''Malevolence''." ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Matchstick|imagecat=Images of Matchstick}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'' *{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' {{Imo}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *{{InsiderCite|106|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season One Episode Guide, Part One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season One Episode Guide, Part One}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#34: Matchstick|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW34_Matchstick.asp}} *{{InsiderCite|115|Blaster}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Matchstick |es=Matchstick/Leyendas |ja=マッチスティック |nl=Matchstick |pl=Matchstick |deGA=1 }} [[Category:Clone trooper pilots]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Shadow Squadron personnel]]
